surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during the plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) of MoS2 involve two half-reactions. The first reaction is the surface reaction between the Mo(CO)6 precursor and H2S plasma, forming a surface-bound Mo-S species and releasing H2 and CO. The second reaction is the surface reaction between the surface-bound Mo-S species and another molecule of Mo(CO)6, forming a Mo-S-Mo surface species and releasing H2 and CO.
evidence: The two half-reactions during the PEALD of MoS2 are described as follows: Mo(CO)6* + H2S → Mo‒SH* + H2(g) + CO(g) and MoSH* + Mo(CO)6 → Mo‒S‒Mo(CO)x* + H2(g) + CO(g). The surface species are denoted with an asterisk (*).
